note: Post hoc test, written after the studies. Each checked or curated value is given to the checker again with its number moved by 1%, 10% and 30%, down and up. The script check needs the claimed number inside the quote. The local judge (votes 1 and 2 in a study) sees the claimed value, the quote, the source title and URL; here the quote stands in for the source text around it. The Wonder vote (vote 3 in a study) is not run, to keep Meta model spending at zero. In a study a value is used only if every check passes.
judge: Muse Glimmer 30B Q4_K_M, local llama.cpp, reasoning low
